_comment: Separate typecheck program for the VENDORED dental-scope 3D engine only.
Why this exists: the app's root tsconfig excludes vendor/, so without this
program the P4/S3 Dentora patches would never be typechecked anywhere.
It checks the vendored tree on the library's own terms - `strict: false`,
matching the style the upstream code was written against - so the errors
reported are real ones, not a strictness mismatch.
`allowImportingTsExtensions` is required because upstream imports use
explicit `.ts` suffixes; it forces `noEmit`, which is what we want anyway.
Deps resolve from the app's node_modules: three, three-mesh-bvh, zustand.
`src/main.tsx` is EXCLUDED: it is the upstream Vite app entry, which mounts
the engine's own React chrome and @vercel/analytics. Nothing imports it and
we never render it - PATCH 7 hides that chrome - so typechecking it would
